Pink Top & Camo Knit Skirt
Rights check
Source: 24384.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, wavy light brown
hair in a half-up style wears a dusty pink long-sleeve
top with thin tonal seams and a short cream sweater
skirt with a cloud-like pattern. Cream ribbed tights and
gray chunky leg warmers. A gray puffer bag hangs from
one shoulder, and gray chunky sneakers complete the
look. Her expression is calm. Plain white studio
backdrop, even light. Palette of dusty pink, gray, and
cream. Playful and cozy, in the style of a Y2K-inspired
lookbook.
Soft, playful, cozy
WORKING NOTES
- The leg warmers and cloud-print skirt set the playful
tone.
- Use 'full-length' to show the leg warmers and sneakers.
